notes: Variant unit WLC.LEV.21.5.v001 was resolved to r00-base, covering s002; the projection carries that reading and no new textual decision is made here (rule 9).

Both neither and nor are read as rule 35 fusions of a written waw with a written lo'; the competing reading would give the connective to the waw and mark the negative unrepresented, which rule 35 forbids where the negative is actually present.
Each fusion pairs the waw that opens a clause with the negative standing in that same clause, so s007 pairs with s011 and s013 with s017.
